title: Rumba dance steps for beginners - Rumba basic steps (American Style)

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains steps clearly with a calm and encouraging demeanor, demonstrating from multiple angles. He breaks down movements for both partners separately and together while emphasizing weight changes.

lesson_structure.note: Demonstration of the side basic step to music
Introduction of instructors and dance style
Breaking down the steps from the back view
Demonstrating partner connection and men's steps
Explanation of leading and following technique
Tips on upper body stillness and hip action

common_mistakes: Moving the upper body and shoulders at the same time as the steps

steps_taught.name: Side Basic Step
steps_taught.description: Step side and change weight from foot to foot

what_works: Separate demonstrations for men and women

quotes.text: It's called the side basic step.
Now let's break down the steps.
all you're doing is changing weight from foot to foot
the upper body, the arms, and the frame is very still
the upper body and the lower body are kind of separate
